Eye Pattern - Metallic Irises.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Metallic Irises
Irises with a reflective, metallic sheen — gold, silver, copper, or other metal tones catching light like polished metal.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Metallic Irises.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both irises have a polished metallic sheen — the iris color reads as brushed or reflective metal rather than organic tissue. Apply metallic iris finish using selected eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
